deals.metaGraphCaption: The Year-Round Stage of Vienna: Life at the Rathausplatz Set against the striking neo-Gothic backdrop of Vienna’s City Hall, the Rathausplatz serves as the city’s most dynamic historic square, constantly transforming to host major cultural events throughout the year. The cycle begins in winter with the world-famous Vienna Christmas Dream market, which seamlessly transitions into the Vienna Ice Dream (Wiener Eistraum), turning the square into a massive, illuminated ice-skating landscape. As the weather warms, the space becomes a summer hub for the renowned Film Festival, pairing free open-air music and opera screenings with diverse international culinary stands. Right now, the grand square is hosting the beloved Circus Roncalli. Set up directly in front of the Rathaus, the iconic circus tent brings its signature blend of nostalgic charm, poetic acrobatics, and modern, animal-free artistry to the heart of the city. Whether it is spring cultural festivals, summer cinema, autumn spectacles, or winter magic, the Rathausplatz remains the vibrant center of Viennese civic life. #ViennaRathaus #Rathausplatz #CircusRoncalli #ViennaEvents #VisitVienna

deals.metaGraphCaption: 🌇 Bachata Sunday on the Rooftop! 💃🕺🍷 Feel the magic of Bachata in the unique atmosphere of the La Divina Kunstsalon rooftop! Join us for a summer evening filled with music, dance, art, wine and inspiring encounters – all with a beautiful view over Vienna and the sunset in the background. ✨ Whether you’ve never danced Bachata before or you’re just taking your first steps – this evening is for you! Come on your own, with friends, or with your dance partner. Everyone is warmly welcome! 💫 Program: 💃 17:00–18:30 Bachata Workshop for Beginners Learn your first steps and the basics of Bachata while enjoying the relaxed atmosphere of our rooftop. ✨ The workshop will be held in English and Polish. 🕺 18:30–20:00 Bachata Social Evening Time to dance, relax and meet lovely people who share a passion for wine, art and inspiring conversations. 🍷✨ 🍷 Our Wine Bar will be open throughout the entire event. Enjoy your favorite drink and the unique atmosphere of La Divina – a place where dance, art and meaningful connections come together. 📅 11 October 2026 🕔 17:00–20:00 📍 La Divina Kunstsalon Rooftop Lützowgasse 14 / 8th floor 1140 Vienna 🎟️ Tickets: €35 – payment by bank transfer (reservation required) €45 – payment on the day at the venue 📩 Registration & reservations: Send us an email at kontakt@ladivina.at. After your registration, you will receive the bank details for the payment. Your spot will be confirmed once the payment has been received. ⚠️ Limited number of spots available! Save your spot and spend a special Sunday with us, filled with dance, wine, art and inspiring conversations! 💃🍷✨ #BachataVienna #DanceVienna #ViennaEvents #RooftopVienna #winelover

deals.metaGraphCaption: KÜRBISFEST AM HIMMEL 🎃 Das Kürbisfest am Himmel findet traditionell jedes Jahr Ende Oktober statt, diesmal sogar drei Tage lang von Samstag, 24. bis Montag, 26. Oktober. Es gibt Schmankerl aus der Steiermark, einen Kürbisbauernmarkt und ganz viele verschiedene Kürbisse zum Kochen und Dekorieren. Du kannst deinen Kürbis auch gleich vor Ort schnitzen. 🎃🤎 Für Kinder gibt es einen Drachenbastel-Workshop und wer möchte, kann den Drachen gleich auf der Wiese steigen lassen. 🪁 Am Himmel liegt wunderschön in Döbling und es lässt sich richtig gut mit einem Spaziergang z.B. durch die Weinberge oder zum Cobenzl verbinden. 🍂 📅 Sa, 24. bis Mo, 26. Oktober 2026 🕞 10 - 18 Uhr 💶 gratis 📍Am Himmel, Himmelstraße 125 / Ecke Höhenstraße, 1190 Wien #gratisinwien #herbstinwien #wienevents #kürbisfest

cardEditorial.originalDescription: 👧👴 Jung & Alt gemeinsam in Bewegung! Am 12. Dezember 2026 dreht sich bei unserem Workshop-Tag alles um neue Ideen und Methoden für die intergenerative Bewegungsarbeit. Von 09:00 bis 16:30 Uhr stehen vier spannende Themen auf dem Programm: 🎵 Musik, Rhythmus und Tanz für Jung & Alt ♻️ Generationen miteinander in Bewegung bringen – alternative Bewegungsmaterialien 🪑 Sesselgymnastik im intergenerativen Setting 🌿 Bewegte Begegnungen in der Natur – Intergenerative Waldpädagogik Mit Uschi Gatol, Caro Lassnig und Marianne Friedrich erhalten die Teilnehmer*innen zahlreiche Anregungen für die Arbeit mit unterschiedlichen Generationen – von unmittelbar einsetzbaren Bewegungsformen bis zu methodischen Grundlagen für intergenerative Angebote in der Natur. 📅 12. Dezember 2026 🕘 09:00–16:30 Uhr 📍 Erster Wiener Turnverein, Schleifmühlgasse 23, 1040 Wien 📩 Anmeldung unter office@asvoewien.at 📋 Die Teilnahme ist kostenlos! „Jung & Alt – Gemeinsam Gesund“ ist ein Projekt der Wiener Gesundheitsförderung – WiG. Der Bereich der intergenerativen gesundheitsorientierten Bewegungsförderung wird von ASKÖ WAT Wien, ASVÖ Wien und SPORTUNION Wien umgesetzt. #ASVÖWien #JungUndAlt #GemeinsamGesund #WiG #Gesundheitsförderung #Bewegung #Generationen #Workshop #Wien

deals.metaGraphCaption: Ultravox – Vienna [Deluxe Edition] (Chrysalis Catalogue, 2LP, 40th Anniversary Edition, 2020) When it comes to the ‘80s, Ultravox must have a seat at the senators’ table. During the period with John Foxx on vocals, they delivered stunning works of punk deconstructed on the teachings of Eno-Bowie. Later, with the arrival of Midge Ure, they veered towards a more synthetic and melodic sound. At this point, critics turned their backs on the group with a snobbish and superficial attitude, often grouping them with chart-topping bands and the numerous awful trash that sprouted like mushrooms during that time. It was a time of hedonism, an era marked by superficiality, but also by latent and hidden tensions. When evaluating a work, one should free oneself from prejudices and compartmentalized labels. One should look deep into its value, dissecting its deepest aspects with clarity, which was not done. “Vienna” is a small masterpiece, which may well not appeal to everyone, but it says a lot about the period in which it was conceived. It is a revealing album, that “speaks” of its era, representing, for better or worse, its salient aspects. by DeBaser - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - studio.bassan ultravoxuk #vienna #80s #classic #album

deals.metaGraphCaption: 🍂 10th Wiener Herbsttage at the Palmenhaus 🎃 Vienna hosted the autumn exhibition 10th Wiener Herbsttage at the Palmenhaus — one of those cozy Viennese events where you just want to stop and admire every little detail. 🍁 The historic Palmenhaus was transformed into a charming autumn harvest exhibition. Visitors could discover more than 60 varieties of apples and wild fruits, including old and rare varieties that are almost impossible to find in an ordinary supermarket. 🍎🍏 There was also a lovely autumn market, where you could taste and buy a variety of regional products: honey, chocolate, fruit and herbal specialties, pumpkin seed products, delicious treats and much more. 🍯🍫🎃 Plant lovers also had plenty to discover: exotic plants, cacti, figs, perennials, rare fruit plants, saffron and flower bulbs. 🌿🪴 You could not only admire them, but also buy some of your favorites to take home. And, of course, one of the highlights was the atmosphere itself. 🤎 Pumpkins, dried flowers, beautiful autumn arrangements, plants and vibrant harvest colors made everything feel incredibly cozy and full of autumn charm. It was such an interesting and inspiring event — a lovely opportunity to discover something new while simply enjoying the beauty of autumn in Vienna. 🍂 📍 Palmenhaus im Burggarten — Burggarten 1, 1010 Vienna 🇦🇹 📅 9–11 October 2026 🕙 10:00–18:00 🎟️ Free admission Autumn in Vienna definitely knows how to surprise you. 🍁🎃✨ #WienerHerbsttage #Palmenhaus #ViennaAutumn #ViennaEvents #vienna

It was such an interesting and inspiring event — a lovely opportunity to discover something new while simply enjoying the beauty of autumn in Vienna. 🍂 📍 Palmenhaus im Burggarten — Burggarten 1, 1010 Vienna 🇦🇹 📅 9–11 October 2026 🕙 10:00–18:00 🎟️ Free admission Autumn in Vienna definitely knows how to surprise you. 🍁🎃✨ #WienerHerbsttage #Palmenhaus #ViennaAutumn #ViennaEvents #vienna
